headline: Evening Exchange Centers on Weathered Expanse, Fisherman's Row
war_summary: Evening wires to the 18:10 edition show the exchange quickening in the west and south after the afternoon lull. The Weathered Expanse adds six seizures in two hours about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch to the hour, standing now four Warden, four Colonial and one unheld with 10,397 Colonial and 11,005 Warden losses for the day. Fisherman's Row reports nine seizures in two hours about Black Well, Dankana Post, Fort Ember and Eidolo to 17:33, standing nine Colonial with day losses of 399 and 648 and sharply quickened hourly rates. The Gutter counts five seizures in two hours about The Parras to 17:42 for seven Warden, while Linn Mercy adds two seizures to the hour about Lathair and Rotdust for ten Colonial and one unheld. Farranac Coast shows no seizures in two hours since 15:58 about Transient Valley and The Bone Haft and stands eleven Colonial. Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf record no seizures in six hours despite heavy day lists, with Buckler Sound and Thornhold last noted at 04:57 and 09:23.
